(* EXPOSED SIGNATURE DIAGNOSTIC v91, NOT the complete report protocol.
   One protected signing key, public (m,sig,record), arbitrary claimed identities,
   SID and epochs. The same verification key is deliberately reused for these
   claims to isolate standalone signature binding from key-distribution policy.
   Secrecy is intentionally not tested: m and sig are public in this scenario. *)
type uid.
type epoch.
type sessionid.
type root.
type coins.
type dsaPK.
type dsaSK.
type signature.
free c:channel.
free idTX,idRX,otherTX,otherRX:uid.
fun DSApk(root):dsaPK.
fun DSAsk(root):dsaSK.
fun Sign(dsaSK,bitstring,coins):signature.
reduc forall d:root,m:bitstring,r:coins;
 Verify(DSApk(d),m,Sign(DSAsk(d),m,r))=true.
fun SessionRecord(uid,uid,sessionid,epoch,epoch):bitstring [data].
event EvidenceSigned(bitstring,bitstring).
event EvidenceAccepted(bitstring,bitstring).
query rec:bitstring,m:bitstring;
 event(EvidenceAccepted(rec,m)) ==> event(EvidenceSigned(rec,m)).
query rec:bitstring,m:bitstring; event(EvidenceAccepted(rec,m)).
process
 new rootTX:root;
 out(c,DSApk(rootTX));
 (
  !(
   new s:sessionid; new et:epoch; new er:epoch;
   new m:bitstring; new r:coins;
   let rec=SessionRecord(idTX,idRX,s,et,er) in
   let sg=Sign(DSAsk(rootTX),m,r) in
   event EvidenceSigned(rec,m);
   out(c,(idTX,idRX,s,et,er,m,sg))
  ) |
  !(
   in(c,(tx:uid,rx:uid,s:sessionid,et:epoch,er:epoch,m:bitstring,sg:signature));
   let rec=SessionRecord(tx,rx,s,et,er) in
   if Verify(DSApk(rootTX),m,sg)=true then
   event EvidenceAccepted(rec,m)
  )
 )

earlier_baseline.source_utf8:
(* PQC ProVerif audit v44. Derived from pqc_wrapped_v43.pv.
   DEFAULT PROTOCOL IS UNCHANGED: signs m, no ACK; server has enrolled roots;
   authenticated confidential control links; attacker-controlled data channel.
   Added events/queries observe ACTUAL values. They are not extra messages.
   The CFB/PUF/KW/KEM abstractions and single-use RX premise are inherited.
   Scope: one honest pair, arbitrarily many sessions, ideal symbolic primitives.
   Device capture, public evidence and server failure are separate scenarios.
   Do not equate request authentication with explicit key confirmation, or
   verified TX signature origin with non-repudiation against the trusted server.
*)

(* SCENARIO: Current Fig. 5 assumptions, expanded observation-only queries. *)

type uid.
type device.
type challenge.
type helper.
type root.
type seed.
type coins.
type sessionid.
type iv.
type macKey.
type mac.
type kemPK.
type kemSK.
type kemCT.
type shared.
type kek.
type contentKey.
type wrappedKey.
type dsaPK.
type dsaSK.
type signature.
type payloadCT.

free idTX, idRX: uid.
free c: channel.
free rt, st, sr: channel [private].
const request, certRX, certTX: bitstring.
const pqc_p1: bitstring.

(* Enrolled PUF and successful MV/BCH reconstruction. *)
fun PUF(device, challenge): root [private].
fun MV(root): root.
fun BCH(root): helper.
fun BCH_decode(root, helper): root.
equation forall d:device, ch:challenge;
  BCH_decode(MV(PUF(d,ch)),BCH(MV(PUF(d,ch)))) = MV(PUF(d,ch)).

(* Public, identity-bound, role-separated KDF interfaces. *)
fun kemSeed(root, uid): seed.
fun dsaSeed(root, uid): seed.
fun credentialKey(root, uid): macKey.
fun HMAC(macKey, bitstring): mac.
fun bodyRX(sessionid, challenge, helper, kemPK): bitstring [data].
fun bodyTX(sessionid, challenge, helper, dsaPK): bitstring [data].

(* ML-KEM: z does not change the public key / valid-ciphertext secret. *)
fun KEMpk(seed): kemPK.
fun KEMsk(seed, coins): kemSK.
fun EncapsCT(kemPK, coins): kemCT.
fun EncapsSS(kemPK, coins): shared.
fun Decaps(kemSK, kemCT): shared.
equation forall s:seed, z:coins, r:coins;
  Decaps(KEMsk(s,z),EncapsCT(KEMpk(s),r)) = EncapsSS(KEMpk(s),r).
fun KDF(shared, sessionid): kek.

(* AES-KW, with failure if the wrapped key does not match the KEK. *)
fun Wrap(kek, contentKey): wrappedKey.
reduc forall k:kek, m:contentKey; Unwrap(k,Wrap(k,m)) = m.

(* Pure ML-DSA: a fixed application context, no external prehash step. *)
fun DSApk(seed): dsaPK.
fun DSAsk(seed): dsaSK.
fun Sign(dsaSK, bitstring, coins, bitstring): signature.
reduc forall s:seed, m:bitstring, r:coins, ctx:bitstring;
  Verify(DSApk(s),m,Sign(DSAsk(s),m,r,ctx),ctx) = true.

(* Data encoding and unauthenticated payload-encryption abstraction. *)
fun Pair(bitstring, signature): bitstring [data].
fun Frame(iv, payloadCT): bitstring [data].
fun CFBenc(contentKey, iv, bitstring): payloadCT.
fun ChangeMessage(payloadCT, bitstring): payloadCT.
fun ChangeSignature(payloadCT, signature): payloadCT.
fun CFBdec(contentKey, iv, payloadCT): bitstring.
equation forall k:contentKey, v:iv, p:bitstring;
  CFBdec(k,v,CFBenc(k,v,p)) = p.
equation forall k:contentKey, v:iv, m:bitstring, s:signature, a:bitstring;
  CFBdec(k,v,ChangeMessage(CFBenc(k,v,Pair(m,s)),a)) = Pair(a,s).
equation forall k:contentKey, v:iv, m:bitstring, s:signature, a:signature;
  CFBdec(k,v,ChangeSignature(CFBenc(k,v,Pair(m,s)),a)) = Pair(m,a).

(* Events bind claims to ACTUAL per-session values, not shadowed free constants. *)
event SessionSecret(sessionid, shared).
event WrappingSecret(sessionid, kek).
event ContentSecret(sessionid, contentKey).
event MessageSecret(sessionid, bitstring).
event EncapsulationCoins(sessionid, coins).
event SigningCoins(sessionid, coins).
event IssuedRXKey(sessionid, kemPK).
event IssuedTXKey(sessionid, dsaPK).
event TXCheckedRX(sessionid, kemPK).
event RXCheckedTX(sessionid, dsaPK).
event RXRequested(sessionid).
event TXSigned(sessionid, bitstring).
event TXSent(sessionid, bitstring).
event RXAccepted(sessionid, bitstring).

event RootTX(root).
event RootRX(root).
event DSASeed(seed).
event KEMSeed(seed).
event SigningKey(dsaSK).
event DecapsulationKey(sessionid,kemSK).
event CredentialTX(macKey).
event CredentialRX(macKey).
event TXRequested(sessionid).
event TXReadyKey(sessionid,shared,contentKey).
event RXAcceptedKey(sessionid,shared,contentKey).
event TXSignature(bitstring,signature).
event RXVerified(bitstring,signature).

(* Q01-Q06: no actual honest-session secret is derivable. *)
query s:sessionid, k:shared; event(SessionSecret(s,k)) && attacker(k).
query s:sessionid, k:kek; event(WrappingSecret(s,k)) && attacker(k).
query s:sessionid, k:contentKey; event(ContentSecret(s,k)) && attacker(k).
query s:sessionid, m:bitstring; event(MessageSecret(s,m)) && attacker(m).
query s:sessionid, r:coins; event(EncapsulationCoins(s,r)) && attacker(r).
query s:sessionid, r:coins; event(SigningCoins(s,r)) && attacker(r).
(* Q07-Q08: accepted public-key records were issued by the server. *)
query s:sessionid, pk:kemPK; event(TXCheckedRX(s,pk)) ==> event(IssuedRXKey(s,pk)).
query s:sessionid, pk:dsaPK; event(RXCheckedTX(s,pk)) ==> event(IssuedTXKey(s,pk)).
(* Q09: data origin, Q10: one acceptance per request, Q11: session agreement. *)
query s:sessionid, m:bitstring; event(RXAccepted(s,m)) ==> event(TXSigned(s,m)).
query s:sessionid, m:bitstring; inj-event(RXAccepted(s,m)) ==> inj-event(RXRequested(s)).
query s:sessionid, m:bitstring; event(RXAccepted(s,m)) ==> event(TXSent(s,m)).
(* Q12-Q13: FALSE proves that the corresponding event can actually occur. *)
query s:sessionid, m:bitstring; event(TXSent(s,m)).
query s:sessionid, m:bitstring; event(RXAccepted(s,m)).

query r:root; event(RootTX(r)) && attacker(r).
query r:root; event(RootRX(r)) && attacker(r).
query k:seed; event(DSASeed(k)) && attacker(k).
query k:seed; event(KEMSeed(k)) && attacker(k).
query k:dsaSK; event(SigningKey(k)) && attacker(k).
query s:sessionid,k:kemSK; event(DecapsulationKey(s,k)) && attacker(k).
query k:macKey; event(CredentialTX(k)) && attacker(k).
query k:macKey; event(CredentialRX(k)) && attacker(k).
query s:sessionid,pk:kemPK; event(TXCheckedRX(s,pk)) ==> event(RXRequested(s)).
query s:sessionid,pk:dsaPK; event(RXCheckedTX(s,pk)) ==> event(TXRequested(s)).
query s:sessionid,ss:shared,k:contentKey; event(RXAcceptedKey(s,ss,k)) ==> event(TXReadyKey(s,ss,k)).
query m:bitstring,sg:signature; event(RXVerified(m,sg)) ==> event(TXSignature(m,sg)).

let Server(rTX:root, cTX:challenge, hTX:helper,
           rRX:root, cRX:challenge, hRX:helper) =
  in(st,(=request,=idTX,=idRX,s:sessionid));
  let qTX = DSApk(dsaSeed(rTX,idTX)) in
  let qRX = KEMpk(kemSeed(rRX,idRX)) in
  let tRX = HMAC(credentialKey(rTX,idTX),bodyRX(s,cTX,hTX,qRX)) in
  let tTX = HMAC(credentialKey(rRX,idRX),bodyTX(s,cRX,hRX,qTX)) in
  event IssuedRXKey(s,qRX);
  out(st,(certRX,idTX,idRX,s,cTX,hTX,qRX,tRX));
  event IssuedTXKey(s,qTX);
  out(sr,(certTX,idTX,idRX,s,cRX,hRX,qTX,tTX)).

let TX(devTX:device, cTX:challenge, hTX:helper) =
  in(rt,(=request,=idRX,s:sessionid));
  event TXRequested(s);
  out(st,(request,idTX,idRX,s));
  in(st,(=certRX,=idTX,=idRX,=s,=cTX,=hTX,qRX:kemPK,tRX:mac));
  let rTX = BCH_decode(MV(PUF(devTX,cTX)),hTX) in
  if tRX = HMAC(credentialKey(rTX,idTX),bodyRX(s,cTX,hTX,qRX)) then
  event TXCheckedRX(s,qRX);
  let dTX = DSAsk(dsaSeed(rTX,idTX)) in
  new rKEM:coins;
  new rSign:coins;
  new kContent:contentKey;
  new vector:iv;
  new m:bitstring;
  let ss = EncapsSS(qRX,rKEM) in
  let eSS = EncapsCT(qRX,rKEM) in
  let kWrap = KDF(ss,s) in
  let eSK = Wrap(kWrap,kContent) in
  event SigningKey(dTX);
  let sig = Sign(dTX,m,rSign,pqc_p1) in
  event TXSignature(m,sig);
  event TXReadyKey(s,ss,kContent);
  let eM = Frame(vector,CFBenc(kContent,vector,Pair(m,sig))) in
  event SessionSecret(s,ss);
  event WrappingSecret(s,kWrap);
  event ContentSecret(s,kContent);
  event MessageSecret(s,m);
  event EncapsulationCoins(s,rKEM);
  event SigningCoins(s,rSign);
  event TXSigned(s,m);
  event TXSent(s,m);
  out(c,(eSS,eSK,eM)).

let RX(devRX:device, cRX:challenge, hRX:helper) =
  new s:sessionid;
  event RXRequested(s);
  (* Public context exposure; not an additional protocol request or ACK. *)
  out(c,s);
  out(rt,(request,idRX,s));
  in(sr,(=certTX,=idTX,=idRX,=s,=cRX,=hRX,qTX:dsaPK,tTX:mac));
  let rRX = BCH_decode(MV(PUF(devRX,cRX)),hRX) in
  if tTX = HMAC(credentialKey(rRX,idRX),bodyTX(s,cRX,hRX,qTX)) then
  event RXCheckedTX(s,qTX);
  new z:coins;
  let dRX = KEMsk(kemSeed(rRX,idRX),z) in
  event DecapsulationKey(s,dRX);
  (* One-use continuation models the atomic pending-to-used requirement. *)
  in(c,(eSS:kemCT,eSK:wrappedKey,eM:bitstring));
  let ss = Decaps(dRX,eSS) in
  let kWrap = KDF(ss,s) in
  let kContent = Unwrap(kWrap,eSK) in
  let Frame(vector:iv,ct:payloadCT) = eM in
  let Pair(m:bitstring,sig:signature) = CFBdec(kContent,vector,ct) in
  if Verify(qTX,m,sig,pqc_p1) = true then
  event RXVerified(m,sig);
  event RXAcceptedKey(s,ss,kContent);
  event RXAccepted(s,m);
  0.

process
  new devTX:device;
  new devRX:device;
  new cTX:challenge;
  new cRX:challenge;
  let rTX = MV(PUF(devTX,cTX)) in
  let rRX = MV(PUF(devRX,cRX)) in
  let hTX = BCH(rTX) in
  let hRX = BCH(rRX) in
  let qTX = DSApk(dsaSeed(rTX,idTX)) in
  let qRX = KEMpk(kemSeed(rRX,idRX)) in
  event RootTX(rTX);
  event RootRX(rRX);
  event DSASeed(dsaSeed(rTX,idTX));
  event KEMSeed(kemSeed(rRX,idRX));
  event CredentialTX(credentialKey(rTX,idTX));
  event CredentialRX(credentialKey(rRX,idRX));
  (* Completed enrollment/login is the starting premise for Fig. 5. *)
  out(c,(idTX,idRX,cTX,hTX,cRX,hRX,qTX,qRX));
  ((!Server(rTX,cTX,hTX,rRX,cRX,hRX)) |
   (!TX(devTX,cTX,hTX)) | (!RX(devRX,cRX,hRX)))
